description:
A learner completed one High-Variability Phonetic Training (HVPT) trial: a single forced-choice discrimination or identification judgment on a Korean phonetic contrast (e.g. tense/aspirated/plain laryngeal stops), presented by one talker in one phonetic environment. This is the raw stimulus/response/outcome/latency record for a single trial -- it carries no knowledge-state axis values, no BKT/CAS posterior, and no propagation weights. The private CAS Strength/Stability/Automaticity update for the contrast node is computed elsewhere from a stream of these records; this record only says what was presented and how the learner responded. Companion to the reading-side tools.spec.event.*.encountered family: HVPT trials are the domain-general analogue described in B9 Continuous Acquisition Spectrum Model S5 (same three-axis state and update equations, different observation model).
Korean examples:
  contrastId=hvpt:contrast:stop_laryngeal_dtt (다/따/타), trialFormat=AXB, talkerId=talker:f-seoul-02
  contrastId=hvpt:contrast:vowel_eu_eo (으/어), trialFormat=identification_2afc, talkerId=talker:m-busan-01

trialId.description: Unique identifier for this trial. Format recommendation: hvpt-{sessionId}-{seq}.

sessionId.description: Groups all trials from one HVPT training session. Distinct from a reading tools.spec.lifecycle.session.started sessionId, but may co-occur with one if HVPT is embedded in a mixed-activity app session.

trialIndexInSession.description: 0-based position of this trial within its session. Used for within-session fatigue/warm-up analysis, and as a context-novelty input alongside talkerId (B9 S3.3).

contrastId.description: Canonical id of the phonetic contrast/category under training. Format recommendation: hvpt:contrast:<name> (e.g. hvpt:contrast:stop_laryngeal_dtt). This is the raw analogue of a reading-side patternId -- the node id private CAS state is tracked against. The catalog of valid contrastIds is maintained as private/dictionary-adjacent reference metadata, not defined in this record.

trialFormat.description: Forced-choice paradigm used for this trial, per the standard HVPT/phonetic-training literature (Logan, Lively, & Pisoni 1991).

stimulus.description: What was actually presented to the learner -- raw, verifiable facts about the trial, not an interpretation of the learner's knowledge.

talkerId.description: Canonical id of the talker/voice used for this trial's audio. This is the raw signal behind HVPT's own high-variability-training design principle and feeds the private context-novelty multiplier (B9 S3.3) exactly the way content domain does for reading.

phoneticEnvironment.description: Phonetic/positional environment of the target sound (e.g. word_initial, intervocalic, word_final, pre_nasal).

surface.description: Orthographic/romanized form of one stimulus token in this trial (e.g. one of 다/따/타 for an AXB trial).

audioRef.description: Optional reference to the audio asset played for this token.

role.description: The token's role within the trial's forced-choice structure.

responseGiven.description: Which stimulus/category the learner selected (e.g. the surface form or role of the chosen token). Raw response, not a correctness judgment.

correct.description: Whether responseGiven matched the trial's target. This is the raw c_n signal feeding the private CAS Strength (W) and Stability (kappa) axes, exactly as outcome/Y does for reading encounters.

confidence.description: Optional graded self-reported confidence in the response, for HVPT designs that use graded rather than strictly binary trials. This is the learner's own raw self-report, not a computed evidence weight.

rtMs.description: Raw reaction time in milliseconds from stimulus onset (or offset, per trialFormat convention) to response. Direct signal for the CAS Automaticity (F) axis observation model (B9 S3.4/S5.1) -- HVPT trial software can log this natively, unlike casual reading which only has the coarser outcome-based proxy.

presentedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the stimulus was presented.
